title: Embeddable pages, SVG blocks, translated titles and steadier brain run
why: Apps embedded by another local panel were blocked by a fixed X-Frame-Options DENY, SVG children of blocks were created as HTML, <meta seo title={t()}> printed the key in dev, workers never started under brain run, and writes under output/ reloaded the page mid-work.
changelog: brain.json csp.frameAncestors lists who may embed the pages (X-Frame-Options follows it)
<meta seo title={t('…')}> is translated in brain run
brain run sends COEP and CORP on scripts, so *.worker.jsbrain starts
brain run ignores output/ and plain .gitignore entries when it watches files
Several urlState writes in one handler land in one history entry
route() shows the destination when the new view mounts after a client navigation
brain run respects server.timeoutMs above 30 s and queues a second load() instead of failing at 5 s
